# Blueprint Schema Atlas — v2.7 Relationships

Two relationship views: the **typed-ID vocabulary** (how entities reference each other inside a model) and the **cross-file references** (how schema files depend on each other). Both are derived from JSON Schema `$ref`s and metamodel patterns.
